methodology: 12 highlighted counties plus any Census county sharing a boundary point (including corner contacts): 33 counties. HHSC general/special and psychiatric hospital directories, supplemented by official federal, state and university hospital pages. Limited-services rural directory screened; none in scope. Outpatient-only clinics and freestanding ERs excluded. Same-license separate addresses retained. University main-campus services consolidated. This inventory is a dated source snapshot, not a guarantee of completeness or current admission availability.
coordinateMethod: 88 current addresses matched to HHSC public July 2024 location points (ten abbreviation/unit differences manually reviewed); 15 published-address Esri geocodes; one coordinate from the hospital operator. All points checked against the mapped county polygons. Address/campus estimates, not surveyed buildings or landing pads.
